prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone BACKGROUND ONLY for a high-quality fantasy mobile game barracks, landscape 16:9. The attached image is a STYLE and lighting reference, not a screen to copy. Paint a richly detailed interior volcanic fortress training hall / forge, cold deep blue stone architecture, vaulted doorway receding in centre, massive iron chains, red and gold banners, braziers and smithing fires, worn dark stone floor with subtle orange lava cracks and warm reflected light, atmospheric blue depth with bright orange fire glow around the edges. Match the polished painterly cartoon 3D-like art quality, textured stone and metal, soft lighting and confident silhouettes in the reference. Composition: open visually calm main area, especially right half where opaque live UI panels will be overlaid; on left keep enough open floor and background for a separate hero and pedestal. NO hero, NO characters, NO weapons as primary subjects, NO pedestal in the foreground (provided separately), NO UI, NO panels, no text, no symbols or counters, no watermarks. Full bleed opaque background, avoid extreme lens effects.
prompts.pedestal: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated stone demonstration pedestal sprite on genuine transparent alpha background. Attached image is style reference only. A broad low circular two-tier volcanic stone dais seen from a slightly elevated front angle, polished hand-painted fantasy mobile game art, irregular detailed charcoal-blue stone blocks, orange glowing lava seams and a warm orange illuminated flat top where a live game character will be placed. Cool blue edge highlights, substantial stone thickness, chunky texture and bevels, soft contact shadow contained within sprite. Horizontal oval silhouette, width about twice the height, centered and entirely visible with 8% clear padding. NO character, no ball, no weapon, NO UI plaque, no lettering, no star or numbers, no surrounding scenery, no floor extending outside the pedestal, no watermark. Transparent background must be real alpha, not a painted checkerboard or black/white matte.
prompts.ui: Create ONE production mobile game UI sprite atlas, transparent background, EXACT 2 columns by 3 rows on a 1536x1024 canvas, all six cells same 768x341; each component centered inside its cell with 24px transparent gutter. Six blank rectangular frames: row1 left large navy iron panel with thin aged bronze double bevel border, row1 right same with blue-steel edge; row2 left wide chunky navy metal button bronze rim, row2 right selected wide button rich burnished gold and amber glow confined inside cell; row3 left small dark navy stat inset card silver/slate rim, row3 right weapon collectible card gold rim. Painted high quality fantasy mobile game, dark forge, subtle scratched metal, crisp sculpted corners, restrained ornament, calm empty interior to receive live text. ALL frames rectangular gently chamfered corners, never tilted, full frontal. No words, text, letters, symbols, icons, numbers, characters or weapons. Real alpha outside each frame, no checkerboard, no background. Similar art direction to attached barracks concept, high craftsmanship.
prompts.icons: Create ONE game UI icon atlas, EXACT 4 columns by 3 rows on a 1536x1152 transparent canvas; each cell 384x384, centered icon occupying 65% with large transparent padding, all cells strictly aligned. Painted premium fantasy mobile-game icon art, thick crisp edges, bright legible highlights, dark thin outline and restrained shadow. Row1: red glossy heart; silver sword with golden hilt; blue wing for movement speed; purple spiral for weapon rotation. Row2: orange impact burst with a small upward arrow for hit growth; green plus with leaf for healing; golden sun-shaped XP badge with letters XP (only this icon may contain these letters); bright golden five-point star for evolution. Row3: blue jigsaw puzzle piece for merge; bronze padlock; two golden upward chevrons for rank; green shield with luminous border for ability. Isolated symbols, no panel, no background, no other letters/numbers. True alpha, no checkerboard.
